purpose: Draft, non-final raw frames for the CURRENT post-Appeeky five-frame store story order (problem hook -> life events -> result -> evidence -> privacy/offline demo). This folder is a scratch draft, NOT a shipped locale pack: 'en-current-draft' is not a supported store locale, so the compositor write/dry-run pipeline never consumes it. It does not overwrite or replace the canonical screenshots/store/en pack.
captureHarness: test/tool/raw_screenshot_capture_test.dart (committed Flutter-test harness). Run one frame per process, opt-in: RECTIFY_CAPTURE_RAW_SCREENSHOTS=1 RECTIFY_CAPTURE_FRAME=<id> flutter test test/tool/raw_screenshot_capture_test.dart
source: Shipped Flutter UI (package rectify) rendered from real widgets, routes, and Demo-mode state. No marketing mockups, no fabricated screens.
captureMethod: RenderRepaintBoundary.toImage(pixelRatio: 3) over the real RectifyApp, offline Demo mode (no network), navigated through the real calculation_flow controller and go_router. All bundled fonts (text + MaterialIcons + Lucide) loaded from FontManifest.json so glyphs and icons render real.
network: none (Demo mode is fully offline; no network calls, no HTTP)

frames.title: Problem hook
frames.shows: The unknown-birth-time entry point: 'Do you know an approximate birth time?' with 'I have an approximate time' / 'I have no idea', an approximate time, a search window, and the derived range copy. Frames the core problem in real shipped input UI.
frames.intendedCaption: Don't know your exact birth time?

frames.title: Life events input
frames.shows: Populated life-events list (5 added): Education milestone (2008), Relocation (2012), Career change (Sep 2015), Marriage / Partnership (Jun 2018), Birth of child (Mar 2021), with 'Add event' and 'Continue (demo)'.
frames.intendedCaption: Add the life events you remember.

frames.title: The result
frames.shows: Existing canonical raw frame. Estimated time 7:14 AM, Gemini Rising, 78% confidence, alternates, DEMO badge. Referenced unchanged; not copied here.
frames.intendedCaption: Estimate your birth time and rising sign.

frames.title: The evidence
frames.shows: Existing canonical raw frame. Per-event STRONG/MODERATE/WEAK breakdown behind the candidate time. Referenced unchanged; not copied here.
frames.intendedCaption: See the evidence behind every candidate.

frames.title: Private & offline demo
frames.shows: Existing canonical raw frame. Demo mode toggle (free, no network), time format, Delete all data. Referenced unchanged; not copied here.
frames.intendedCaption: Private by default. Try it free, offline.

shareFrameStatus: Optional / bonus under the current plan, not one of the required five. The canonical screenshots/store/en/04-share-result.png remains available if a bonus share frame is composited.
limitations: DRAFT, not final. No marketing caption overlays and no device bezels: these are raw device-resolution captures only. Caption compositing (current plan captions above) and device framing are owner work.
Frames 3-5 are REFERENCES to the canonical screenshots/store/en pack, not copies. The canonical pack is unchanged.
Times/signs/percentages in the referenced result/evidence frames come from the offline canonical DEMO dataset; the DEMO badge is visible in-frame.

No final composited PNGs were generated. The guarded compositor write path (tool/store_screenshot_compositor_write.dart) is unchanged and still refuses final writes for the canonical pre-Appeeky manifests.
